note: Eighth set (2026-11-12): walking commands that state a number, for the comparison with text-to-motion models (experiments/t2m_compare). Written by Claude before any model was run on them. Each command names one quantity; the measured value of the generated walk is compared with the stated value. Angles (lean, head, knees, arms, legs, toes) are measured as the change from the same method's plain walk ("걸어" / "A person walks forward."), cadence and speed as absolute values. The English text is given to models that take English. Do not edit after its first run.

commands.en: A person walks forward with the upper body leaning forward by 20 degrees.
A person walks forward with the upper body leaning forward by 40 degrees.
A person walks forward with the head bowed down by 30 degrees.
A person walks forward at 140 steps per minute.
A person walks forward at 90 steps per minute.
A person walks forward at a speed of 0.6 meters per second.
A person walks forward at a speed of 1.8 meters per second.
A person walks forward with steps 1.5 times longer than usual.
A person walks forward with the knees bent 30 degrees more than usual.
A person walks forward with both arms raised forward to 90 degrees.
A person walks forward with both arms raised sideways to 45 degrees.
A person walks forward with each leg spread 10 degrees outward.
A person walks forward with the toes turned 30 degrees further outward.
